[WP] Every day you wake up, you're the master of some new trade or skill, however insignificant or important, and upon sleeping, you lose all confidence and mastery of that ability.

Hey Harold show us that awesome thing you showed us yesterday with the fancy writing.

Harold, agitated as always by being asked to show his previous talent, smiled and gave his classmates the finger. It was called calligraphy and you guys know that I can't do that again, but want to see what I can do today?

Bobby and Marten laughed, and agreed to see Harold's new daily talent.

Alright guys stand back today I'm going to need room to run. I'm going to run into that tree next to you guys, Harold said as he took a deep breath, and then I'm going to swing on to the roof of the school. I'm an acrobatic marvel today. He slowly counted to himself. One, two, three, and he started sprinting towards the tree next to his friends.

Bobby laughed and joked to Marten, wouldn't it be funny if he just runs into the tree?

Now sprinting as fast as he could, Harold couldn't help thinking to himself, ohhh man this is going to hurt bad if I mess up my footing. As he got to the tree he didn't slow down at all. He knew it would take all of his momentum to make the jump to the first branch, and started to run up the trunk of the the tree. It felt strange at first, as it always does showing his new talent, then quickly becoming a master. Harold counted the steps, he knew going more than three steps on the trunk would prevent him from getting the best jump.

Placing his left foot firmly on the hard trunk of the tree, he bent both knees and then placed his right foot next to the left. He kicked away from the tree as hard and as fast as he could. It looked as if he'd become a spring jumping to uncoil it's compressed self.

Harold reached out his hands for the first branch, and grabbed on, swinging his legs quickly to the front of himself to keep the momentum going. He was now focused on the second branch. He knew he could make it to the school's roof from there. Swinging backwards and then forwards again building even more force, he let go of the branch and again reached forward for the second one. He managed to tightly grip the second branch and began swinging again.

The second branch was thinner and had a lot more movement than the first. Harold was expecting this, and was going to use the branch like a rubber band to slingshot himself to the roof. Swinging back and forth he heard the breach cracking. Harold knew he could only swing backwards once more, or the branch would break off from bending so much and he'd be in a world of pain if that happened. He swung forward one last time, the branch pulling him forwards plus his momentum was just enough.

Harold released the second branch and quickly spun in the air to get a quick glimpse of Bobby and Marten and began waving at his friends knowing he'd have plenty of time to spin back for his landing.

Starring blankly at Bobby, Marten smiled slowly and began laughing. Whelp he technically did run into the tree.

Focusing on the perfect landing now Harold spun back around and began to plan how he wanted to land. He didn't want to hit too hard and shake the roof, but he also didn't want to break his legs landing to softly. He decided he'd land start rolling to the flat surface. The roof was getting closer now, and he began to bend his legs sightly. He hit the roof with a soft thud and quickly tucked into a ball to keep his momentum from causing him to face plant on the roof.

He continued to roll for what felt like miles to him, but was really only about eight feet, until he came to a stop on the flat part of the roof. He heard a teacher storm out of the school to see what the commotion was. Harold was far enough back on the roof that he couldn't be seen, but he kept low just to be sure he wasn't caught.

Bobby and Marten were now laughing hysterically, at both the terrible joke and the confused teacher, causing them to be scolded for the noise.

Harold heard his friends stop laughing only to breathe and then continue laughing. He peeked over the edge to see the top of the teachers head as they walked back into the school. Once he was sure he couldn't be seen or heard by the teacher, he yelled down to his friends, hey guys how do you suppose I get down from here I want to show you some other tricks.

His friends smiled and pointed to the pipe on the side of the school. They smirked and in unison yelled back, good luck bro, as they laughed and whet into school as the bell rang for classes to begin.
